summary: Four tools that treat motion as data, not decoration — and what that distinction buys you.

note.en: Framer Motion stripped to its spring core and shipped framework-free. The sequencing API is the part people wanted; the React wrapper was the tax.
note.zh: Framer Motion 剥到只剩弹簧内核，脱离框架单独发货。人们真正要的是它的序列 API；React 包装反而是税。

note.en: the timeline library that keeps outliving its obituaries. Every year brings a new animation framework, and every year they borrow its sequencing model.
note.zh: 一个总在讣告里活下来的时间轴库。每年都有新动画框架，每年都在借它的序列模型。

note.en: smooth scrolling as a small, polite dependency. It doesn't hijack the scrollbar or fight the browser; it just rounds the edges.
note.zh: 把平滑滚动做成一个小而守规矩的依赖。不劫持滚动条，不和浏览器对着干，只把棱角磨圆。

note.en: a design tool that grew a site builder on top of itself. The people who stay are the ones who treat its animation panel as the whole point.
note.zh: 一个在自己身上长出建站器的设计工具。留下来的人，都把它的动效面板当成唯一理由。
